description: Look up a US bank by name (legal or common, e.g. "Chase", "state street") and return its FDIC certificate number, city, state and total assets. Use this first: every other tool needs the certificate. Optionally narrow by two-letter state.

query.description: Bank name, or words from it; a city name also matches.

state.description: Two-letter state code to narrow the search, e.g. MA.

name: search_banks
title: Find a bank's FDIC certificate number
